'''Darth Scabrous''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Sith alchemist/Legends|alchemist]] who served as the [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]] of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Water/Legends|frozen]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]].

==Biography==
Scabrous sought to extend his life indefinitely, and so attempted to create an ancient Sith formula devised by [[Darth Drear]] that would grant him [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] using the [[Murakami orchid]]. The formula also resulted in the partial resurrection of those who had already [[Death/Legends|died]], but turned them into cannibalistic [[Zombie/Legends|monstrosities]]. Scabrous commanded hordes of these creatures during his lifetime.<ref name="RedHarvestPreview">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/redharvest_chapter1/index.html|text=Plunge Into ''Red Harvest'' Preview Now}}</ref> It was rumored that Darth Scabrous granted [[Sith training|secret training]] sessions to [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Rance Lussk]], during which he taught Lussk techniques in [[Mind trick/Legends|mind control]].

Scabrous planned on using the orchid's caretaker, [[Hestizo Trace]], in a sacrificial ritual in which he would cut out her [[Heart/Legends|heart]] and eat it, allowing the high [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] count in it to stabilize the formula and truly render himself immortal.

However, Hestizo managed to escape, with the sacrifice of her brother [[Rojo Trace|Rojo]], and managed to kill Scabrous with his own sword.
